en.headline: Fortune-telling stall at Wong Tai Sin Temple burgled
en.dek: A lock was forced overnight and about HK$4,000 in cash was taken from a stall beside the temple, police and local reports said.
body: A fortune-telling stall at Wong Tai Sin Temple was broken into overnight, with about HK$4,000 in cash reported stolen, according to local media and police inquiries at the scene.

The operator returned shortly before 8am on Tuesday and found the cylinder lock damaged. After lifting the shutter, drawers were open and the stall had been ransacked. Police classified the case as burglary.

The operator told reporters the stall had been left as usual after 4pm on Monday and that more than HK$3,000 in Hong Kong notes and more than RMB700 were missing. The operator said the stall had traded at the temple for more than a decade without a previous theft and planned to add another lock.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠解籤檔遭爆竊 失約四千元
zh.dek: 解籤檔匙膽被撬，檔主周二早上開舖發現櫃筒被翻，失港幣三千多元及人民幣七百多元。
body: 黃大仙祠一間解籤檔被人爆竊，檔主點算後報失約四千元現金，警方列爆竊案調查。
檔主今早約7晈48分返回開舖時打不開門，發現匙膽被破壞，拉起大閘後見舖內有搜掠痕跡，櫃筒被打開。警方到場調查。
檔主表示周一約下午4時離開時一切正常，失竊包括三千多元港幣散紙及七百多元人民幣。檔主稱在祠內開業十多年從未遇竊，之後會加鎖加強保安。
